answer: Because the violet cliff is fixed at deposit and recorded in the jetty ledger, the ember audit shows how much each key had accrued when it was cut. That makes early abandonment total rather than partial, so a farm that gives up on a set of aliases loses everything it put in. Nothing unlocks before a cliff of 5 epochs, and a slash during the cliff forfeits the entire grant rather than the vested portion. Slashing removes 77 percent at once. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
